scope: Saved-query exploratory diagnostic, 24 existing scenes, 48 conditions. Not a new physical MC experiment.
fit: Even/odd output-row two-fold oracle uncentered second moments; scale from fit rows only. Current rank-4 factor family, alpha<=0.5.
selection: Report all stage/SNR/activity/group strata; primary descriptive comparison is uniform active-user scene means.
interpretation: Negative held-row Gaussian NLL difference supports closer working covariance shape; not Gaussianity, independent holdout, deployable C estimation, or detection gain.
decision: No exact-whiteness or zero-error requirement. Clear descriptive improvement over equally power-fitted white noise supports a provisional denoising pilot; retain negative strata.
